text:
Lena Ortiz: heads-up 1-launch plan for the benchmark newsletter + compact 2-email nurture. main constraints: localized subjects, small asset pack, and clear replay routing.
Caleb Moore: agree. suggest region splits: Americas Thu 10am PT, EMEA Fri 10am CET, APAC Mon 10am SGT. we should localize subject + date strings.
Rina Park: segmentation: inbound_tag=bench_post OR utm_campaign=bench_launch => invite list. high_intent = clicked_bench_cta OR visited=/benchmarks/docs -> immediate invite; others into 48h nurture. I'll prepare exports Wed 6am PT.
Omar Diaz: ops: run seed list 24h prior, 5% canary for first 10 minutes, pause if bounce_rate>1%. set webhook tag payload: `lead_id={{id}}, tags=[bench_inbound]`.
Lena Ortiz: copy asks: 1) two subject variants (personalized + generic), 2) 90-char preheader, 3) 25-char hero line. can someone draft?
Caleb Moore: I'll draft subjects: A) "Benchmark released + live demo" B) "See how we cut token costs". will make B the dev-targeted variant.
Rina Park: localization-bot noted for FR/DE/JP translation. localization-bot: please drop translated subjects by Tue 18:00 UTC to qualify.
Omar Diaz: deliverability: suppress unsubscribed, bounced_90d, active_customers. throttle EU concurrency if ISP errors spike. retries for webhook = 3.
Lena Ortiz: analytics: track open->register->replay. Caleb, can you own dashboard so we can watch register velocity?
Caleb Moore: yes; I'll add subject and region breakdown and post link here once ready.
Lena Ortiz: timeline: copy + assets Tue EOD, segment export Wed 6am PT, seeds Wed 9am PT, Americas send Thu 10am PT. owners: Caleb (copy+analytics), Rina (segmentation), Omar (ops), Lena (launch).
Rina Park: uploading segment CSV to shared drive after export. will ping ops when done.
localization-bot: Reminder: Translation window closes 2025-05-12T18:00:00Z.
Lena Ortiz: great work team 1; keep QA notes only in thread during final window. :rocket:
